timing_scope: Accumulator::update only, including casts and existing row encoding; binding, resize, input creation, group-ID generation, state/output materialization, storage and pipeline scheduling excluded
control_layout: All four factorial controls share the same enum state, runtime minimum field and update pointer. Exact before/after modules retain their own production layouts.
order: Six-way balanced cyclic order, two cycles per case; case order shuffled per process
summary_method: median of three process medians; retain each process and paired round ratios
distinct_hash_control: All variants clone a shared RandomState per process during resize (outside timing), using the same hash algorithm and seed; each process receives a fresh seed.
production_module_note: Before/after update kernels are copied without algorithm changes; only resize uses the shared hash-seed constructor to control DISTINCT hash collisions. black_box on mutable accumulator prevents constant propagation of the selected type/function at the timed call site.
build: cargo build --release --locked; default release profile, no RUSTFLAGS override
